name: Primior Holdings Inc.
summary: Primior Holdings Inc., operates as a real estate investment firm. It engages in the management and development of solutions; provision of investment advisory; and asset management services. The company was formerly known as GRILLiT, Inc. and changed its name to Primior Holdings Inc. in October 2024. Primior Holdings Inc. was founded in 2012 and is based in Irvine, California.
